Input contract
--------------
There are M<infinity lattice sites, two bosonic flavors b,c, beta>0, and
separately conserved particle numbers. The source-specific Hamiltonian is

 H = sum_ij [b_i^dag K_ij b_j + c_i^dag K_ij^* c_j]
     + U1 sum_i (n_bi-n_ci)^2 + U2 sum_i (n_bi+n_ci)^2,          (P1)

where K=K^dag, U1>=0, U2<=0. Source arXiv:2610.31541v1, Eq. S157,
has real frustrated triangular-lattice K and additionally allows a pairing
term. All canonical claims below set that pairing term Delta=0. They do not
apply to generic Kramers matrices mixing the two flavors, to unequal fixed
populations, or to the number-nonconserving paired model.

L is a finite positive integer and delta=beta/L. Let phi_i,l and psi_i,l
be independent standard real Gaussians. With g=-U2>=0, the HS factor is

 exp[-delta U1 (n_b-n_c)^2 + delta g (n_b+n_c)^2]
 = E exp[sqrt(2 delta g) phi (n_b+n_c)
          + i sqrt(2 delta U1) psi (n_b-n_c)].                 (P2)

The Gaussian measure is positive. At fixed fields the two single-particle
propagations are B and B^*. Symmetric kinetic splitting is used in the code.
These are ordinary HS and canonical-AFQMC operations; see Shen et al. 2020,
2023. The results below specify which ensemble makes their composition valid.


Proposition 1. The printed attractive grand-canonical Hamiltonian is unstable.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
For U2<0 and Delta=0, Tr exp[-beta(H-mu N)] is infinite for every finite real
mu, every M>=1 and beta>0, with the uncut local bosonic Fock spaces.

Proof. Fix one site j. The normalized Fock vectors v_n with n b-bosons and
n c-bosons on j and zero elsewhere are mutually orthogonal, lie in distinct
total-particle sectors, and obey

 <v_n,(H-mu N)v_n> = 2n K_jj + 4 U2 n^2 - 2 mu n.             (P3)

The U1 term vanishes. Every off-diagonal hopping term has zero expectation.
The negative quadratic term dominates the linear term. In each fixed-number
sector H is a finite Hermitian matrix. Convexity of exp gives

 <v_n,exp[-beta(H-mu N)]v_n>
 >= exp[-beta(2n K_jj+4 U2 n^2-2 mu n)].                       (P4)

The positive trace is bounded below by the sum of (P4) over n. That sum
diverges. This is an exact ensemble instability, not a statement about the
size of a Monte Carlo error bar. A finite-occupation reference or a physical

# Independent mathematical review of the bosonic ensemble interface

Root independently derives and accepts the following statements at their exact
mathematical scope. This is not a review of every claim in the source or the
worker's production calculation, and establishes no practical speed advantage.
Source: Yu,Wei,Li,[arXiv2610.31541v1](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.31541v1),
22October2026, equationsS95–S108,S157–S163. The worker independently found the
same obstruction and constructs a finite-sector calculation.

## The attractive grand-canonical source is unstable

For U1>0,U2=-g<0 in S157, take the orthonormal Fock vectors with n bosons of
each flavor on one site and none elsewhere. Relative density is zero. Hopping
and pairing have zero expectation. Thus <H-mu N>=-4g n²-2mu n. Convexity of
the exponential gives <exp[-beta(H-mu N)]> >= exp(4beta g n²+2beta mu n).
For beta>0 and finite mu these terms grow without bound. Summing diagonal
matrix elements proves that the uncut grand-canonical trace is infinite.
A finite-occupation reference is a different mathematical model.

## The printed positive determinant weight is itself non-normalizable

Consider Delta=0,U1>0,U2<0, a finite lattice of M sites and any finite positive
Trotter slice count. Split each independent HS Gaussian field into its normalized
uniform all-site/all-time component and orthogonal residuals. Conditional on
residuals, scalar uniform potentials commute through every slice. The single
flavor propagation is

    B = exp(beta mu + a Phi + i b Psi) R,
    a=sqrt(2beta |U2|/M)>0, b=sqrt(2beta U1/M)>0.

R is invertible because it is a finite product of matrix exponentials. Pick any
eigenvalue lambda of R. Finite real Phi0,Psi0 solve
exp(beta mu+a Phi0+i b Psi0)lambda=1. As a function of the complex scalar
s=aPhi+i bPsi, det(I-exp(beta mu+s)R) is analytic and has a zero of integer
multiplicity k>=1 there. Locally the source's conjugate-flavor weight
|det(I-B)|^(-2) behaves as a positive constant times |s-s0|^(-2k).

The two-dimensional Gaussian density is strictly positive at this finite point,
and the map from (Phi,Psi) to complex s is nonsingular. The local radial
integral contains integral_0^epsilon r^(1-2k)dr=infinity. Any additional smooth
positive exponential prefactor stays bounded below on a small neighborhood.
Thus the conditional positive integral diverges for every residual field.

Read complete PROOFS.txt, RESULT.txt, core code, CLAIMS.json and both actual
parent reviews; inspected structured main/control/stress records and independent
reference. Reuse the completed review at proof8f32fd2875c6060a224b86ae09d5ba5c111afe6a16ed6f2a97c66281f62ed355,
coreb3c4791dd001b6793ee277776503b1e509ab1a8a109e6e426fca178debc06108,
main datae10b05dfa0873bcf6d9ead73c7c508622223b78365549039c2cdc9cf88374bbb.
The source-specific uncut U2<0 grand-canonical trace diverges by Fock diagonal
growth. For U1>0,U2<0,Delta0 the two uniform HS coordinates move a nonzero
eigenvalue of invertible R to a determinant pole. Its positive two-dimensional
integral diverges; Tonelli is applicable. This does not invalidate the paper's
explicit finite-occupation reference/regularization, all other source methods
or its separate stable U2=0 trace-convergent regime. The dispatcher completed
that primary-source scope check; no full third-party paper is republished.

Separately conserved equal flavor populations yield the finite polynomial
|h_n(B)|². Total-number projection does not: the one-mode N2 coefficient at
B=i is-1 while the balanced1,1 coefficient is1. The printed sin formula extends
the counterexample to each fixed N>=1. Finite-dimensional HS integration and
Trotter convergence, ordinary Newton recursion without diagonalizability,
uniform-mode scalar exp(4beta|U2|n²/M), raw/centered second-moment multiplier
exp(8beta|U2|n²/M), and the first thermal derivative's finite second moment
have actual completed parent acceptance. No higher-observable variance or
uniform sampling complexity follows. The parent's independent100-state ED
and inspected four million-field floating runs retain accepted computational
scope; this intake did not rerun them. Ordinary ED was much faster on this
fixture. Nine-site stress accuracy remains UNKNOWN. CLAIMS.json's older
limited-review wording is historical; the later complete REVIEW.md controls
current acceptance. Both originals are retained without rewriting either.
